pages.title: Barbary Lion
pages.text: The Barbary lion ($(o)Panthera leo leo$()) is a population of lion that once lived in North Africa, from Morocco to Egypt, including the Atlas Mountains.$(br2)Lions from this region were captured in great numbers for the Roman arenas. Historical accounts describe males with heavy, dark manes.$(br2)Persecuted for centuries, the Barbary lion was hunted out of the wild by the middle of the twentieth century.
